# 17 — Components & Resources

Every crafting component and raw resource is also a small 3D prop: it shows up as loot, in inventory icon renders, floating in zero-G, and piled on construction-stage frames. Prop rules: pivot at the base center, one 512² texture (or a slot in the shared prop atlas), LOD1 at 50%, collision is one box or convex hull (`UCX_`).

## Construction-stage piles

Frames at BS1/BS2 show component piles instead of empty scaffolds. Each component has a `SM_CMP_<Name>_Pile` variant (3–5 stacked units, ≤ 600 tris) that the construction system scatters on the frame's floor.
